summary:
The Sanji manga alternate art parallel numbered OP06-119 arrives through Premium Booster: the Best Vol.2, and its catalog label carries an identification detail worth reading closely: English above Japanese on the border. That notation is not decorative. It records how the text is laid out on the card frame, and it is the kind of marker collectors and graders use to separate printings that would otherwise be indistinguishable in a cropped photograph. Sanji himself is the Straw Hat crew's cook, a fighter who uses only his legs so his hands stay fit for cooking, chasing a sea called the All Blue where every ocean's fish swim together.

### Basic Info
*   **Main subject / card theme:** Sanji, cook of the Straw Hat Pirates
*   **Set or product (catalog label):** 2025 Premium Booster: the Best Vol.2 (Prb-02) - English Manga Alt. Art Parallel (En Above Japan On Border)
*   **Card number:** OP06-119
*   **Language version(s):** English printing with English above Japanese on the border, per the catalog label
*   **Rarity / treatment:** Manga alternate art parallel from a premium compilation product
*   **Set label year:** 2025

### Community Pulse
This card sits at the centre of the identification problem that defines late One Piece collecting. Premium Booster compilations reissue popular artwork, English and Japanese printings coexist under the same numbers, and border text layout becomes a real differentiator rather than trivia - which is exactly why the catalog label spells it out. Experienced buyers ask for full-frame photographs including the border before committing, and listings that omit them move slowly. The second thread is the recurring compilation debate: whether reissuing sought-after artwork adds supply or simply makes it reachable without import friction. Sanji-specific demand is solid and character-led; he is a core crew member with his own dedicated collectors, though he does not attract the speculative attention that follows Luffy. Condition follows the manga-art norm, with monochrome panels exposing print lines and centering plainly.

### Card Fun Facts
*   Sanji fights exclusively with his legs to protect the hands he cooks with - a self-imposed limitation that doubles as his defining character trait.
*   The All Blue, the legendary sea where fish from every ocean meet, is his ambition, making him the crew member whose dream is culinary rather than martial.
*   Border text layout - which language sits above which - functions as a printing fingerprint on cards where the same number spans multiple language editions.

### Summary (TLDR)
OP06-119 manga-art Sanji is an English parallel from the 2025 Premium Booster: the Best Vol.2 compilation, identified partly by having English above Japanese on its border. Demand is steady and character-led, and its market runs on precise printing identification more than on scarcity claims.
